what: P03 live-run checklist steps 1-8 on the full local stack

environment.services: make up-core (3 Kafka 3.9.1 brokers, Apicurio 3.3.3, MinIO, metastore PostgreSQL, Spark 3.5.7 master and worker) plus Trino 483 and ClickHouse 25.8; named volumes reused

bronze_checkpoint_recovery.problem: The saved bronze checkpoint pointed at Kafka offsets (for example 361 and 311) that the 24-hour topic retention had deleted; failOnDataLoss=true stopped the job with OffsetOutOfRangeException.
bronze_checkpoint_recovery.kafka_state: Every partition's earliest offset equalled its latest (topic empty); total offsets 3,162 = 2,142 deliveries bronze had read + 1,020 published on 19 October for the ClickHouse-only stage, which therefore never reached bronze.
bronze_checkpoint_recovery.action: Started bronze with GAMESTREAM_BRONZE_CHECKPOINT=s3a://warehouse/checkpoints/bronze-2026-10-22 (startingOffsets earliest on an empty topic, so nothing old was re-read). The old checkpoint was left in place. No code changed.

benchmark.note: 5 timed runs after 1 warm-up per engine and query; the script's p95 with 5 samples is the 4th-smallest value. Trino times include a new DB-API connection per query; ClickHouse uses one HTTP POST per query.

restart_test.fixture: restart-v1, seed 20261022, 200 unique IDs, 204 deliveries, start 2026-02-03
restart_test.with_hook: GAMESTREAM_SILVER_FAIL_AFTER_MERGE=1: InjectedRestartFailure after the MERGE for batch 9 (37 input rows); silver 2,137 rows, 2,137 distinct
restart_test.after_restart: batch 9 replayed (37 input rows, no new rows), batch 10 added 167; restart prefix 200 rows / 200 distinct; silver 2,300 rows / 2,300 distinct
restart_test.checkpoint_and_shuffle: silver checkpoint location and the 200 shuffle partitions unchanged

limits: One local run over synthetic fixtures; not a general Trino-versus-ClickHouse speed claim.
Bronze now uses a new checkpoint path; the 19 October ClickHouse-stage deliveries are not in bronze.
Dashboards show synthetic fixture data; they demonstrate the wiring and export, not product insight.

airflow.first_runs: manual_2026-10-22_live and the scheduled 2026-10-20 run: silver_quality_gate succeeded, dbt_build failed after 3 attempts with 'Read-only file system: /opt/gamestream/dbt/logs/dbt.log' (the dbt project is mounted read-only)
airflow.fixed_run: manual_2026-10-22_fixed: success; quality gate Metrics(rows=2300, missing_ids=0, duplicate_ids=0, invalid_types=0, future_events=0); dbt build PASS=31 WARN=0 ERROR=0 (7 table models, 1 view, 23 tests) in 4.32 s

superset.browser_check: headless Chrome 155: live operations 3/3 charts rendered, product analytics 4/4, 0 error alerts; screenshots superset/exports/*_2026-10-22.png
superset.data_note: The data covers three synthetic days (2026-01-01, 2026-02-01, 2026-02-03), so line charts join across the gap; D1/D7 retention is 0 because the fixtures have no returning users. Charts were not filtered to those dates.
